XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on, sporadic misfires
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0011 | PHASE | TIMING | DISTRIBUTION | CAMS | P0009 | MIL | VARIABLE | VARIATOR | IRREGULAR | 2 CYLINDERS | 3 CYLINDERS | PHONIC | WHEEL | OIL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Phonic wheel

  • Fault: Following replacement of the timing belt, the engine fault light comes on with sporadic misfires

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0011 (Camshaft phase advance adjustment 1), P0009 (Bank 2 timing error)

  • Cause: Failure to adjust the phonic wheel

• Intervention: Perform the phonic wheel adjustment procedure

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: After disconnecting and reconnecting the phonic wheel, which is necessary in order to replace the timing belt, it is essential to perform the phonic wheel adjustment procedure.
